infographic.title: How a Pressure Switch Works
infographic.alt: Infographic showing four steps of pressure switch operation: pressure acts, spring opposes, element moves, contact changes
steps: Process pressure pushes on a diaphragm, piston or bourdon tube.
An adjustable range spring resists the force and sets the trip point.
When pressure beats the spring force, the element moves a push rod.
The rod snaps a microswitch: NO contacts close and NC contacts open.
